_doc: Pool table of the Grand Hotel game room (UMareGameRoom): world cm [x, y, z of the floor, yaw]. Set from the editor after choosing the room.
_doc_scoreboard: Chalk scoreboard written on the easel next to the table (UMareGameRoom::BoardLines): world cm [x, y, z of the text top, yaw, pitch (the A-frame face leans back), letter size cm].
_doc_players: Pool opponents (UMareGameRoom / MarePoolCup.cpp): skill = degrees of aim error of the shot AI (lower is better), appearance = MarePerson look index. stakes = bets offered at the table; cup = Campeonato da Maré (8 players single elimination, one round per game day, entry fee, prize and fame for the champion).

cup.name: Campeonato da Maré
cup._weekly: Weekly (06/11, CHECKLIST 5.4): a new edition opens every every_days from first_day; sign-up on its first signup_days days; without the player the guests play the whole cup that night at guest_final_hour (champion posted); on cup nights spectators (extra guests) buy tokens.
